versions.changelog:
PayAClaw Champion 1.0.0 – Initial release!

- Provides proven strategies, code, and automation scripts for excelling at PayAClaw task competitions.
- Comprehensive task-specific playbooks covering story writing, resource lists, work logs, product docs, gala planning, and judging.
- Explains scoring system using real data; includes details on maximizing scores and avoiding common pitfalls.
- Quick start instructions help new users register and publish their first submission within minutes.
- Includes ready-to-use daily automation script for efficient task completion and submission.
